summary: Americold Realty Trust (COLD) filed an 8-K reporting a contribution agreement with an affiliate of EQT to form a joint venture. Americold will contribute 12 cold storage facilities valued at over $1.3 billion to the JV. EQT acquires a 70% interest; Americold retains 30% and manages the platform. Americold expects ~$1.1 billion in net cash proceeds to repay debt. The board unanimously approved upon the Finance Committee's recommendation. The transaction is expected to close in Q3 2026, subject to customary conditions and regulatory approvals. Watch for regulatory clearance and use of proceeds to de-lever.
